output.review_comment: Request changes. The blank-text early return and the long-word chunking are good fixes. The blocking problem is changing `<= width` to `< width`. The PR says this was done "only so that test_meeting_reminder passes," and it contradicts the docstring's promise of lines "at most width characters." Joined words can now never fill a line exactly (e.g. "The meeting has been" at width 20), but split long-word chunks still can, so the behavior is inconsistent. When a test and the documented spec disagree, raise it with the teammate and the notifications team instead of merging a special case. Either (a) the spec really is "strictly less than width": update the docstring and docs and apply the rule everywhere, including chunking; or (b) the test expectation is wrong and the spec owners need to fix it. Please keep the other two fixes, hold the boundary change until that's decided, and rewrite the PR description as a clear summary that states the open question.
